text.p: Amriyah Cement made net after-tax profits of 128 million pounds ($37.7 million) in the first nine months of 1996/7, 15 percent up on 111 million in the same period of the previous year, analysts said on Tuesday.

The company expects net profit for the whole year, which ends on June 30, to reach 193.2 million pounds, against 157.3 million in 1995/6, they added, quoting figures presented at a meeting of shareholders last week.

They said the company was trading at a P/E ratio of 13.3 based on 1996 earnings, compared with an industry average of 16. At the current market price, about 89.00 pounds a share, the P/E ratio will reach 7.8 in 1997, they added.
